candidate_discovery.selection_rule: Among coherent full top-60 families, choose the family whose shared Last update date is closest to Sep 30. Tie-break earlier date, then lexicographic base URL.

family_definition.entry_parser: All bold labels in document order matching Team: Player, POS, School. Do not rely on malformed OL/LI nesting.
family_definition.pick_numbering_semantics: Sequential overall selections. Concatenate base, Round-1 remainder, then Round 2 in page order; a forfeited first-round slot does not consume an overall selection number.

forfeited_pick_audit_defect.v2_behavior: Required at least 16 parsed entries on the Picks 17-32 companion page for every class.
forfeited_pick_audit_defect.v3_correction: Permit exactly 15 entries on the Round-1 remainder page only for class years with a pre-anchor, independently documented forfeited first-round selection; require at least 60 combined sequential mock entries across the three same-date pages.
forfeited_pick_audit_defect.why_incorrect: The original B17 protocol required top-60 sequential overall selections and allowed structural missing/forfeited selections; it did not require 32 first-round selections in every class.

purpose: Replay B17A after correcting two audit-only implementation defects: the V1 dotted-month timestamp parser and the V2 assumption that every first round contains 32 selections.

timestamp_parser_defect.v1_behavior: Regex captured Last update text only until the first period; Sept. therefore truncated the date before day/year parsing.
timestamp_parser_defect.v2_correction_retained: Parse the month/day/year directly from Last update text and allow dotted month abbreviations.
